traits.plication.note: Outside Coryphoideae every palm's pleated blade splits along its lower folds, so each leaflet is keeled, Λ-shaped (reduplicate), and a feather leaf ends in a pair of leaflets (Dransfield et al. 2008, p. 16; Kaplan 2022, p. 489-492).

traits.note: Mabberley's Plant-book (4th ed., 2017), under Palmae, subfamily V Arecoideae: monoecious or dioecious palms, usually with reduplicately paripinnate leaves (pinnate, with no leaflet at the tip), the flowers in triads of a female between two males; the largest subfamily, 14 tribes.
